description: RoomMaquette leverages iPhone Pro LiDAR and Apple RoomPlan to capture rooms into interactive 3D architectural maquettes and export in USDZ, OBJ, STL, GLTF, DXF, PNG, PDF, and SVG.

apps.localizedDescription: Native Apple RoomPlan LiDAR room scanner for iPhone Pro. Features real-time multi-surface detection, Museum Clay & Basswood 3D architectural rendering, 2D blueprint drafting view, AR QuickLook preview, and USDZ/OBJ/STL/GLTF/DXF/PNG/PDF/SVG export.
